desc:
📦 Build your own dropshipping business and grow it into a massive automated company!

Find winning products, order stock, create ads, process customer orders and reinvest your profits. Expand your warehouse, build a multi-floor headquarters, hire employees and unlock a huge factory with forklifts, conveyors and B2B contracts.

💼 BUILD YOUR BUSINESS
📱 Find products, run ads and manage orders
📦 Expand your warehouse and automate deliveries
👷 Hire and upgrade specialized employees
🏭 Build a factory and complete large contracts
💎 Earn Cash and Gems from factory contracts
💤 Keep earning with Offline Earnings
⚡ Activate a 5-minute Cash Boost
🎁 Collect Daily Rewards
🎮 Play Arcade games and unlock upgrades

Start with one small product and build a dropshipping empire. How big can your company become?

👍 Like and favorite the game for future updates!
